SRC-009:R0001.text: Freeze a protocol semantic baseline before shortening any normative prose, covering phases, transitions, commands, normalization, STATE, ticket and next-action forms, vocabularies, safety gates, checkpointing, authority, recovery, goal/autonomy, continue-to-improve fallthrough, and planned HUSH precedence, with current owner and test evidence for each fact.

SRC-009:R0002.text: Preserve golden outputs for continue, cc, ccc, ship, improve, compound commands, recovery, and dry-run, and require the existing validator, scenarios, and tests to be green before compression.

SRC-009:R0003.text: Continue fallback may run only after existing Work is exhausted, must resume an existing Improve cycle, and must never create an unbounded Improve carousel.

SRC-009:R0004.text: Create saipen/REGISTRY.json as the sole machine-owned registry for closed executable facts, including phases, legal transitions, canonical commands, aliases, shortcuts, confusable normalization, next-action forms, and closed vocabularies, while excluding philosophy and narrative reasoning.

SRC-009:R0005.text: commands.py and validators must consume the registry or runtime structures instead of parsing English prose, and rewriting command prose must leave behavior outputs byte-identical.

SRC-009:R0006.text: Introduce stable Rule IDs only for cross-referenced rules and enforce One Rule equals One Owner, with references replacing normative restatements and validation rejecting duplicate owners.
